claims.statement: For MSR8 in the evidence files, for every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the SAME finite program with the exact exhaustive branch for n<2^20 and the integer-parameter quantum-counted rank/hash tree and known-frequency decoder otherwise recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability greater than 2/3. On EVERY branch its total charged sequential work T=O(n^128 2^((3/4)sqrt(n)sqrt(log2 n)+2sqrt(n)(log2 n)^(-1/4))), jointly with all other resource bounds and clean law below. All outside constants are absolute. All oracle/query gates are expanded as literal row circuits; counted private phase-window storage, private preparations, addressing, generated circuits, failed attempts and source/work caps are included. The huge disclosed finite-range outside constants make no practical speed claim. Its exact numerical growth index is 1/2.

For the SAME MSR8 finite program in the evidence files, for every N>=2 and s, n=ceil(log2 N) and Q the ACTUAL number of source copies acquired including filters and discarded trees, the guaranteed malformed-copy count is tau(n,Q)=0. Every acquired copy must be an independent ideal coset state. Unconditional entire-secret success is greater than 2/3 and all four resource bounds hold jointly on every branch including source/work aborts. No positive-corruption guarantee or maximum-tolerance impossibility is asserted.
